mcp_initialize.instructions: Start with init, add items with put, inspect status and gate before advance. Record reviews and human decisions explicitly. Signed cases require an offline Ed25519 signature checked against the operator-controlled ORGANON_APPROVERS_FILE. Choose local explicitly for trusted development with declared human approvals and separate reviewers; fixture is reserved for synthetic tests. Use report for a readable summary, next task and evidence limits.
